examples.name: Circuit Craftsman
examples.description: Rotate circuit tiles to light every bulb across 40 handcrafted puzzles. Phaser, TypeScript and Vite, with English and Chinese interfaces.

examples.name: Tidal Workshop
examples.description: Build a cozy floating harbor: salvage scrap, craft parts, ship cargo and automate production. Explore islands and earn permanent voyage rewards. Phaser, TypeScript and Vite.

examples.name: Ember Route
examples.description: Forge a deck and manage Heat and Vent through a twelve-floor roguelike journey with branching routes, events, shops and a boss. Phaser, TypeScript and Vite.

examples.name: Wetland Birdwatching
examples.description: Photograph birds in a procedurally generated wetland to fill your field journal. Three.js, Vite and TypeScript.
